title: Bonds are Back!
speaker: Peter Reznicek

macro_themes.view: Yields collapsed with a flight to quality; falling rates should ultimately help equities, but not yet.
Large consolidation since August with failed signals; avoid directional trades until after the midterms.

calls.reason: Gold broke down below consolidation as money rotated from zero-yield gold into bonds.
calls.quote: I do think there's a little bit more pain to be had here in the gold trade

calls.reason: Messy range since August, sitting on uptrend line without breaking; advises no directional trades until after midterms.
calls.quote: I still maintain that you do not want to get into anything directional.

calls.reason: 10y and 30y yields collapsed; watching whether they keep coming down.
calls.quote: look at the 10-year, just quite down. And then TYX is your 30-year. And you can see how they just collapsed.

notes: Transcript says both 'yesterday on Friday' and 'Thursday evening of October 22nd'; used Oct 22. Yield call is mostly observation, low conviction.
